scope: Generic formal tools in CoreLocalGlobal. This shard does not close any original IUT gap.
edge_direction: A -> B means B depends directly on A. Edges include only declarations inside this shard.
external_boundary_policy: External references are retained by name on each node and are not represented as shard nodes or edges.

∀ {n : Type} [inst : Fintype n] [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] (p : ℕ) [inst_2 : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {T : Type u_1} (k : ℕ)
  (U : T → (Matrix n n ℤ_[p])ˣ) (s : Set (n → ZMod (p ^ k))),
  ↑(CoreIntegralActionDescent.saturatedResidues p k U s) =
    ⋃ t, ⇑(CoreIntegralActionDescent.matrixEquiv (CoreIntegralActionDescent.reduceUnit p k (U t))) '' s

{n : Type} →
  [inst : Fintype n] →
    [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] →
      (p : ℕ) →
        [inst_2 : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] →
          (U : (Matrix n n ℚ_[p])ˣ) →
            CoreLatticeStabilizer.action U '' CoreLatticeStabilizer.standardLattice =
                CoreLatticeStabilizer.standardLattice →
              (Matrix n n ℤ_[p])ˣ

∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} (q : X → Y) (e : X ≃ X) (d : Y ≃ Y),
  (∀ (x : X), q (e x) = d (q x)) → ∀ (s : Set Y), ⇑e '' q ⁻¹' s = q ⁻¹' ⇑d '' s

∀ {n : Type} [inst : Fintype n] [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] (p : ℕ) [inst_2 : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {T : Type u_1} (k : ℕ)
  (U : T → (Matrix n n ℤ_[p])ˣ) (s : Set (n → ZMod (p ^ k))),
  ⋃ t, ⇑(CoreIntegralActionDescent.matrixEquiv (U t)) '' ⇑(CoreResidueHaar.reduction p n k) ⁻¹' s =
    ⇑(CoreResidueHaar.reduction p n k) ⁻¹'
      ⋃ t, ⇑(CoreIntegralActionDescent.matrixEquiv (CoreIntegralActionDescent.reduceUnit p k (U t))) '' s

{n : Type} →
  [inst : Fintype n] →
    [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] → {R : Type u_1} → [inst_2 : CommRing R] → (Matrix n n R)ˣ → (n → R) ≃ (n → R)

∀ {n : Type} [inst : Fintype n] [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] {R : Type u_1} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (U : (Matrix n n R)ˣ)
  (x : n → R), (↑U⁻¹).mulVec ((↑U).mulVec x) = x

∀ {n : Type} [inst : Fintype n] [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] {R : Type u_1} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (U : (Matrix n n R)ˣ)
  (x : n → R), (↑U).mulVec ((↑U⁻¹).mulVec x) = x

{n : Type} →
  [inst : Fintype n] →
    [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] →
      (p : ℕ) → [inst_2 : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] → (k : ℕ) → (Matrix n n ℤ_[p])ˣ → (Matrix n n (ZMod (p ^ k)))ˣ

∀ {n : Type} [inst : Fintype n] [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] (p : ℕ) [inst_2 : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (k : ℕ)
  (U : (Matrix n n ℤ_[p])ˣ) (x : n → ℤ_[p]),
  (CoreResidueHaar.reduction p n k) ((CoreIntegralActionDescent.matrixEquiv U) x) =
    (CoreIntegralActionDescent.matrixEquiv (CoreIntegralActionDescent.reduceUnit p k U))
      ((CoreResidueHaar.reduction p n k) x)

{n : Type} →
  [inst : Fintype n] →
    [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] →
      (p : ℕ) →
        [inst_2 : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] →
          {T : Type u_1} → (k : ℕ) → (T → (Matrix n n ℤ_[p])ˣ) → Set (n → ZMod (p ^ k)) → Finset (n → ZMod (p ^ k))

∀ {n : Type} [inst : Fintype n] [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] (p : ℕ) [inst_2 : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {T : Type u_1} (k : ℕ)
  (U : T → (Matrix n n ℤ_[p])ˣ) (s : Set (n → ZMod (p ^ k))),
  (⋃ t, ⇑(CoreIntegralActionDescent.matrixEquiv (CoreIntegralActionDescent.reduceUnit p k (U t))) '' s).Finite

∀ {n : Type} [inst : Fintype n] [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] (p : ℕ) [inst_2 : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {T : Type u_1} (k : ℕ)
  (U : T → (Matrix n n ℤ_[p])ˣ) (s : Set (n → ZMod (p ^ k))),
  CoreIntegralActionDescent.saturatedResidues p k U s = ⋯.toFinset

∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} {T : Type u_3} (q : X → Y) (e : T → X ≃ X) (d : T → Y ≃ Y),
  (∀ (t : T) (x : X), q ((e t) x) = (d t) (q x)) → ∀ (s : Set Y), ⋃ t, ⇑(e t) '' q ⁻¹' s = q ⁻¹' ⋃ t, ⇑(d t) '' s

∀ {n : Type} [inst : Fintype n] [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] (p : ℕ) [inst_2 : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {T : Type u_1} (k : ℕ)
  (U : T → (Matrix n n ℤ_[p])ˣ) (s : Set (n → ZMod (p ^ k))),
  (CoreResidueHaar.latticeHaar p n)
      (⋃ t, ⇑(CoreIntegralActionDescent.matrixEquiv (U t)) '' ⇑(CoreResidueHaar.reduction p n k) ⁻¹' s) =
    ↑(CoreIntegralActionDescent.saturatedResidues p k U s).card / ↑((p ^ k) ^ Fintype.card n)

∀ {n : Type} [inst : Fintype n] [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] (p : ℕ) [inst_2 : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (k : ℕ)
  (U : (Matrix n n ℚ_[p])ˣ)
  (h : CoreLatticeStabilizer.action U '' CoreLatticeStabilizer.standardLattice = CoreLatticeStabilizer.standardLattice)
  (x : n → ℤ_[p]),
  (CoreResidueHaar.reduction p n k)
      ((CoreIntegralActionDescent.matrixEquiv (CoreIntegralActionDescent.fromStabilizer p U h)) x) =
    (CoreIntegralActionDescent.matrixEquiv
        (CoreIntegralActionDescent.reduceUnit p k (CoreIntegralActionDescent.fromStabilizer p U h)))
      ((CoreResidueHaar.reduction p n k) x)
{p : ℕ} → [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] → {n : Type} → (n → ℤ_[p]) → n → ℚ_[p]

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {n : Type} [inst_1 : Fintype n] [inst_2 : DecidableEq n] (U : (Matrix n n ℚ_[p])ˣ)
  (h : CoreLatticeStabilizer.action U '' CoreLatticeStabilizer.standardLattice = CoreLatticeStabilizer.standardLattice)
  (x : n → ℤ_[p]),
  CoreIntegralActionFrame.embed
      ((CoreIntegralActionDescent.matrixEquiv (CoreIntegralActionDescent.fromStabilizer p U h)) x) =
    CoreLatticeStabilizer.action U (CoreIntegralActionFrame.embed x)
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {n : Type}, Function.Injective CoreIntegralActionFrame.embed

{p : ℕ} →
  [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] →
    {n : Type} → [inst_1 : Fintype n] → [inst_2 : DecidableEq n] → (Matrix n n ℚ_[p])ˣ → (n → ℤ_[p]) → n → ℚ_[p]

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {n : Type} [inst_1 : Fintype n] [inst_2 : DecidableEq n]
  (B : (Matrix n n ℚ_[p])ˣ), Function.Injective (CoreIntegralActionFrame.frameEmbed B)

{p : ℕ} →
  [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] →
    {n : Type} →
      [inst_1 : Fintype n] →
        [inst_2 : DecidableEq n] →
          (U B : (Matrix n n ℚ_[p])ˣ) →
            CoreLatticeStabilizer.action U '' CoreLatticeStabilizer.frameLattice B =
                CoreLatticeStabilizer.frameLattice B →
              (Matrix n n ℤ_[p])ˣ

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {n : Type} [inst_1 : Fintype n] [inst_2 : DecidableEq n]
  (U B : (Matrix n n ℚ_[p])ˣ)
  (h : CoreLatticeStabilizer.action U '' CoreLatticeStabilizer.frameLattice B = CoreLatticeStabilizer.frameLattice B)
  (x : n → ℤ_[p]),
  CoreIntegralActionFrame.frameEmbed B
      ((CoreIntegralActionDescent.matrixEquiv (CoreIntegralActionFrame.frameIntegral U B h)) x) =
    CoreLatticeStabilizer.action U (CoreIntegralActionFrame.frameEmbed B x)
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Semigroup G] (a b c : G), a * (b * c) = a * b * c

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {n : Type} [inst_1 : Fintype n] [inst_2 : DecidableEq n] (k : ℕ)
  (U B : (Matrix n n ℚ_[p])ˣ)
  (h : CoreLatticeStabilizer.action U '' CoreLatticeStabilizer.frameLattice B = CoreLatticeStabilizer.frameLattice B)
  (s : Set (n → ZMod (p ^ k))),
  CoreLatticeStabilizer.action U '' CoreIntegralActionFrame.frameEmbed B '' ⇑(CoreResidueHaar.reduction p n k) ⁻¹' s =
    CoreIntegralActionFrame.frameEmbed B ''
      ⇑(CoreResidueHaar.reduction p n k) ⁻¹'
        ⇑(CoreIntegralActionDescent.matrixEquiv
              (CoreIntegralActionDescent.reduceUnit p k (CoreIntegralActionFrame.frameIntegral U B h))) ''
          s

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {n : Type} [inst_1 : Fintype n] [inst_2 : DecidableEq n] (k : ℕ)
  (U B : (Matrix n n ℚ_[p])ˣ)
  (h : CoreLatticeStabilizer.action U '' CoreLatticeStabilizer.frameLattice B = CoreLatticeStabilizer.frameLattice B)
  (x : n → ℤ_[p]),
  (CoreResidueHaar.reduction p n k)
      ((CoreIntegralActionDescent.matrixEquiv (CoreIntegralActionFrame.frameIntegral U B h)) x) =
    (CoreIntegralActionDescent.matrixEquiv
        (CoreIntegralActionDescent.reduceUnit p k (CoreIntegralActionFrame.frameIntegral U B h)))
      ((CoreResidueHaar.reduction p n k) x)

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {n : Type},
  Set.range CoreIntegralActionFrame.embed = CoreLatticeStabilizer.standardLattice

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {n : Type} [inst_1 : Fintype n] [inst_2 : DecidableEq n]
  (B : (Matrix n n ℚ_[p])ˣ), Set.range (CoreIntegralActionFrame.frameEmbed B) = CoreLatticeStabilizer.frameLattice B

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {n : Type} [inst_1 : Fintype n] [inst_2 : DecidableEq n]
  (B : (Matrix n n ℚ_[p])ˣ),
  CoreLatticeStabilizer.frameLattice B = CoreLatticeStabilizer.action B '' CoreLatticeStabilizer.standardLattice

{R : Type u} →
  [inst : CommRing R] →
    {A : Type z} →
      [inst_1 : CommRing A] →
        [inst_2 : Algebra R A] → [IsArtinianRing A] → [IsReduced A] → A ≃ₐ[R] (m : MaximalSpectrum A) → A ⧸ m.asIdeal
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A], IsScalarTower R A A

∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A],
  IsScalarTower R A ((i : MaximalSpectrum A) → A ⧸ i.asIdeal)

{R : Type u} →
  [inst : CommRing R] →
    {A : Type z} →
      [inst_1 : CommRing A] →
        [inst_2 : Algebra R A] →
          [IsArtinianRing A] →
            [IsReduced A] → ↥(integralClosure R A) ≃ₐ[R] (m : MaximalSpectrum A) → ↥(integralClosure R (A ⧸ m.asIdeal))
∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing A] [IsArtinianRing A], Finite (MaximalSpectrum A)

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {A : Type z} [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A] [inst_3 : IsArtinianRing A]
  [inst_4 : IsReduced A] (x : ↥(integralClosure R A)) (m : MaximalSpectrum A),
  ↑(CoreLocalGlobal.IntegralProductBridge.artinianIntegralEquiv x m) = (Ideal.Quotient.mk m.asIdeal) ↑x

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {A : Type z} [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A] [inst_3 : IsArtinianRing A]
  [inst_4 : IsReduced A] (m : MaximalSpectrum A),
  (integralClosure R (A ⧸ m.asIdeal)).val.comp
      ((Pi.evalAlgHom R (fun m => ↥(integralClosure R (A ⧸ m.asIdeal))) m).comp
        ↑CoreLocalGlobal.IntegralProductBridge.artinianIntegralEquiv) =
    (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R m.asIdeal).comp (integralClosure R A).val

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {A : Type z} [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A] [inst_3 : IsArtinianRing A]
  [inst_4 : IsReduced A],
  Subalgebra.map (↑CoreLocalGlobal.IntegralProductBridge.artinianEquiv) (integralClosure R A) =
    Subalgebra.pi Set.univ fun m => integralClosure R (A ⧸ m.asIdeal)

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {A : Type z} [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A] [IsArtinianRing A]
  [IsReduced A] (x : A),
  x ∈ integralClosure R A ↔
    ∀ (m : MaximalSpectrum A), (Ideal.Quotient.mk m.asIdeal) x ∈ integralClosure R (A ⧸ m.asIdeal)

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {ι : Type v} [inst_1 : Finite ι] {B : ι → Type w} [inst_2 : (i : ι) → CommRing (B i)]
  [inst_3 : (i : ι) → Algebra R (B i)] {A : Type z} [inst_4 : CommRing A] [inst_5 : Algebra R A]
  (e : A ≃ₐ[R] (i : ι) → B i) (i : ι),
  (integralClosure R (B i)).val.comp
      ((Pi.evalAlgHom R (fun i => ↥(integralClosure R (B i))) i).comp
        ↑(CoreLocalGlobal.IntegralProductBridge.equiv e)) =
    ((Pi.evalAlgHom R B i).comp ↑e).comp (integralClosure R A).val

{R : Type u} →
  [inst : CommRing R] →
    {ι : Type v} →
      [Finite ι] →
        {B : ι → Type w} →
          [inst_2 : (i : ι) → CommRing (B i)] →
            [inst_3 : (i : ι) → Algebra R (B i)] →
              {A : Type z} →
                [inst_4 : CommRing A] →
                  [inst_5 : Algebra R A] →
                    (A ≃ₐ[R] (i : ι) → B i) → ↥(integralClosure R A) ≃ₐ[R] (i : ι) → ↥(integralClosure R (B i))

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {ι : Type v} [inst_1 : Finite ι] {B : ι → Type w} [inst_2 : (i : ι) → CommRing (B i)]
  [inst_3 : (i : ι) → Algebra R (B i)] {A : Type z} [inst_4 : CommRing A] [inst_5 : Algebra R A]
  (e : A ≃ₐ[R] (i : ι) → B i) (x : ↥(integralClosure R A)) (i : ι),
  ↑((CoreLocalGlobal.IntegralProductBridge.equiv e) x i) = e (↑x) i

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {ι : Type v} [inst_1 : Finite ι] {B : ι → Type w} [inst_2 : (i : ι) → CommRing (B i)]
  [inst_3 : (i : ι) → Algebra R (B i)] {A : Type z} [inst_4 : CommRing A] [inst_5 : Algebra R A]
  (e : A ≃ₐ[R] (i : ι) → B i) (x : (i : ι) → ↥(integralClosure R (B i))),
  ↑((CoreLocalGlobal.IntegralProductBridge.equiv e).symm x) = e.symm fun i => ↑(x i)

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {ι : Type v} [Finite ι] {B : ι → Type w} [inst_2 : (i : ι) → CommRing (B i)]
  [inst_3 : (i : ι) → Algebra R (B i)],
  integralClosure R ((i : ι) → B i) = Subalgebra.pi Set.univ fun i => integralClosure R (B i)

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {S : ι → Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : (i : ι) → Semiring (S i)]
  [inst_2 : (i : ι) → Algebra R (S i)] {s : Set ι} {t : (i : ι) → Subalgebra R (S i)} {x : (i : ι) → S i},
  (x ∈ Subalgebra.pi s t) = ∀ i ∈ s, x i ∈ t i
∀ {α : Type u} (x : α), (x ∈ Set.univ) = True
∀ {b : Prop} (α : Sort u_1) [i : Nonempty α], (∀ (a : α), b) = b

∀ (R : Type u_1) (A : Type u_2) [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A] {a : A},
  (a ∈ integralClosure R A) = IsIntegral R a

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {ι : Type v} [Finite ι] {B : ι → Type w} [inst_2 : (i : ι) → CommRing (B i)]
  [inst_3 : (i : ι) → Algebra R (B i)] (f : (i : ι) → B i), (∀ (i : ι), IsIntegral R (f i)) → IsIntegral R f

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {ι : Type v} [Finite ι] {B : ι → Type w} [inst_2 : (i : ι) → CommRing (B i)]
  [inst_3 : (i : ι) → Algebra R (B i)] (f : (i : ι) → B i), IsIntegral R f ↔ ∀ (i : ι), IsIntegral R (f i)

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {ι : Type v} [Finite ι] {B : ι → Type w} [inst_2 : (i : ι) → CommRing (B i)]
  [inst_3 : (i : ι) → Algebra R (B i)] {A : Type z} [inst_4 : CommRing A] [inst_5 : Algebra R A]
  (e : A ≃ₐ[R] (i : ι) → B i),
  Subalgebra.map (↑e) (integralClosure R A) = Subalgebra.pi Set.univ fun i => integralClosure R (B i)

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {ι : Type v} [Finite ι] {B : ι → Type w} [inst_2 : (i : ι) → CommRing (B i)]
  [inst_3 : (i : ι) → Algebra R (B i)] {A : Type z} [inst_4 : CommRing A] [inst_5 : Algebra R A]
  (e : A ≃ₐ[R] (i : ι) → B i) (x : A), x ∈ integralClosure R A ↔ ∀ (i : ι), e x i ∈ integralClosure R (B i)

{R : Type u} →
  [inst : CommRing R] →
    {ι : Type v} →
      [Finite ι] →
        {B : ι → Type w} →
          [inst_2 : (i : ι) → CommRing (B i)] →
            [inst_3 : (i : ι) → Algebra R (B i)] →
              ↥(integralClosure R ((i : ι) → B i)) ≃ₐ[R] (i : ι) → ↥(integralClosure R (B i))

∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {ι : Type u_3} [Finite ι] {B : ι → Type u_2} [inst_2 : (i : ι) → CommRing (B i)]
  [inst_3 : (i : ι) → Algebra R (B i)] (x : ↥(integralClosure R ((i : ι) → B i))) (i : ι), IsIntegral R (↑x i)

∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {ι : Type u_3} [Finite ι] {B : ι → Type u_2} [inst_2 : (i : ι) → CommRing (B i)]
  [inst_3 : (i : ι) → Algebra R (B i)] (x x_1 : ↥(integralClosure R ((i : ι) → B i))) (i : ι),
  IsIntegral R (↑(x + x_1) i)

∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {ι : Type u_3} [Finite ι] {B : ι → Type u_2} [inst_2 : (i : ι) → CommRing (B i)]
  [inst_3 : (i : ι) → Algebra R (B i)] (x : R) (i : ι),
  IsIntegral R (↑((algebraMap R ↥(integralClosure R ((i : ι) → B i))) x) i)

∀ {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] {ι : Type u_1} [inst_1 : Finite ι] {B : ι → Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : (i : ι) → CommRing (B i)] [inst_3 : (i : ι) → Algebra R (B i)] (x : R),
  (fun i => ⟨↑((algebraMap R ↥(integralClosure R ((i : ι) → B i))) x) i, ⋯⟩) = fun i =>
    ⟨↑((algebraMap R ↥(integralClosure R ((i : ι) → B i))) x) i, ⋯⟩

∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {ι : Type u_2} [Finite ι] {B : ι → Type u_3} [inst_2 : (i : ι) → CommRing (B i)]
  [inst_3 : (i : ι) → Algebra R (B i)] (x : (i : ι) → ↥(integralClosure R (B i))), IsIntegral R fun i => ↑(x i)

∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {ι : Type u_3} [Finite ι] {B : ι → Type u_2} [inst_2 : (i : ι) → CommRing (B i)]
  [inst_3 : (i : ι) → Algebra R (B i)] (x : ↥(integralClosure R ((i : ι) → B i))) (i : ι), IsIntegral R (↑x i)

∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {ι : Type u_3} [Finite ι] {B : ι → Type u_2} [inst_2 : (i : ι) → CommRing (B i)]
  [inst_3 : (i : ι) → Algebra R (B i)] (x x_1 : ↥(integralClosure R ((i : ι) → B i))) (i : ι),
  IsIntegral R (↑(x * x_1) i)

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {ι : Type v} [inst_1 : Finite ι] {B : ι → Type w} [inst_2 : (i : ι) → CommRing (B i)]
  [inst_3 : (i : ι) → Algebra R (B i)] (x : ↥(integralClosure R ((i : ι) → B i))) (i : ι),
  ↑(CoreLocalGlobal.IntegralProductBridge.piEquiv x i) = ↑x i

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {A : Type v} [inst_1 : Field A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A] {ell : ℕ},
  0 < ell → ∀ {x y : A}, y ≠ 0 → x ^ ell = y ^ ell → x • ↑(integralClosure R A) = y • ↑(integralClosure R A)

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {A : Type v} [inst_1 : Field A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A] {ell : ℕ},
  0 < ell → ∀ {x y : A}, (∃ ζ, ζ ^ ell = 1 ∧ x = ζ * y) → x • ↑(integralClosure R A) = y • ↑(integralClosure R A)
∀ {A : Type v} [inst : Field A] {ell : ℕ} {x y : A}, y ≠ 0 → x ^ ell = y ^ ell → (x / y) ^ ell = 1

{R : Type u} →
  [inst : CommRing R] →
    {A : Type v} →
      [inst_1 : Field A] →
        [inst_2 : Algebra R A] → {ell : ℕ} → {ζ : A} → 0 < ell → ζ ^ ell = 1 → (↥(integralClosure R A))ˣ

∀ {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {A : Type u_1} [inst_1 : Field A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A] {ell : ℕ} {ζ : A}
  (hell : 0 < ell) (hζ : ζ ^ ell = 1), ⟨ζ, ⋯⟩ * ⟨ζ⁻¹, ⋯⟩ = 1

∀ {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {A : Type u_1} [inst_1 : Field A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A] {ell : ℕ} {ζ : A}
  (hell : 0 < ell) (hζ : ζ ^ ell = 1), ⟨ζ⁻¹, ⋯⟩ * ⟨ζ, ⋯⟩ = 1

  (hell : 0 < ell) (hζ : ζ ^ ell = 1), ↑↑(CoreTorsionHullStability.torsionUnit hell hζ) = ζ
